extracted.intended_audience: Ohio businesses, regulated entities, and state regulatory stakeholders (agencies, policymakers, interested public)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Ohio's Common Sense Initiative (CSI) program that reviews state agency rules for their impact on business and provides resources and notifications to stakeholders. Focused on identifying regulatory obstacles and driving amendments or rescissions to improve the regulatory climate in Ohio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review focus: business-impacting rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI's stated function is to review rules that affect businesses; the landing page emphasizes that CSI 'reviews business-impacting rules' as a core activity and frames its mission around propelling job and economic growth in Ohio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify regulations that are potential obstacles to businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: identified over 55 percent of those regulations as potential obstacles to Ohio businesses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI has reviewed more than 17,000 state agency rules and identified over 55% as potential obstacles. The page implies that a key evaluative dimension is whether a rule creates obstacles for Ohio businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome standard: amend or rescind identified obstacle rules
rubrics_metrics.description: All of those identified regulations were either amended or rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When CSI identifies regulations as potential obstacles, the practical outcome (per the page) has been amendment or rescission—this sets an implicit standard that identification should lead to regulatory change to reduce business impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide assistance to businesses navigating regulatory obstacles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI's role includes assisting businesses in understanding and managing regulatory burdens; this is a service-oriented criterion relevant to how the program evaluates and supports affected parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead initiatives to improve the regulatory climate
rubrics_metrics.description: leads initiatives to improve Ohio’s regulatory climate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond individual rule reviews, CSI is positioned to lead broader initiatives aimed at improving the overall regulatory environment—an evaluative dimension focused on systemic regulatory reform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to eNotifications to receive agency rule review notices
rubrics_metrics.description: To receive agency rule review eNotifications, please visit the eNotifications page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural guidance for stakeholders to stay informed: subscribing to eNotifications is the stated mechanism for receiving updates about CSI's rule reviews and related news impacting business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Business Impact Analysis (BIA) templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Impact Analysis Template; Business Impact Analysis Template for Rescinded Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to BIA templates as resources—implying that rule evaluations or stakeholder comments should use or consider a Business Impact Analysis. Two templates are provided (general and for rescinded rules), serving as guidance for documenting business impacts.
